summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload on install
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases for the installer's platform/arch, unzips it, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` — a ~727KB single-line obfuscated JavaScript payload using obfuscator.io-style techniques (large numeric/string lookup array, array-rotation function, `with` statements, hex-mangled identifiers). The payload has no readable exports or documented purpose and is unrelated to any code shipped under dist/. Executing the payload through a freshly downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based analysis. The package metadata (author `Christophe Hurpeau <christophe@hurpeau.com>`, homepage) mimics an existing benign author namespace of monorepo test packages, but a legitimate test package would not ship a runtime downloader and an obfuscated 727KB blob invoked from preinstall.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
